The '''refresher booth''' was a personal hygiene refreshment system produced by the [[zZip Product Concepts Limited]] luxury goods company. It featured an [[ultrasonic shower]], which cleaned and invigorated the user by incorporating [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], and the booth also dried the user after their shower. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] sold the product for 2500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. One such booth was available for a fee at [[docking bay 77]] in the [[city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine]].

==Description==
Refresher booths were personal hygiene refreshment systems that contained an [[ultrasonic shower]], which was entirely self-contained and fully automated. The shower did not only invigorate its users as they were cleaned, but due to tiny amounts of specially formulated [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />&mdash;a type of medical substance<ref name="DB">{{DB|technology|bactatank|bacta tank}}</ref>&mdash;incorporated into the shower, it also promoted cellular repair and muscular stimulation. Following a wash, heat induction coils heated the booth to create a warm and refreshing drying cycle. The entire cleaning and drying process only took a user ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />

==History==
The booths were produced by the luxury goods company [[zZip Product Concepts Limited]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Fantastic Technology Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' places its own timeframe between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], respectively.</ref> the [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] company sold refresher booths through its [[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology|product datalog]] for 2500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> The booths were commonly available for purchase in most large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]s. They could often be found for use in [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facilities]], health clubs, and spaceports, and made good places to hide in or use as drop points for [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] goods.<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> One such booth was available at [[docking bay 77]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], a city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine]]. Customers were charged ten credits to use it for a few minutes.<ref name="Smugglers Guide">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Refresher booths were first mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and released by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />
